mapper.sql: id, app_id, app_name, service_name, api, req_params, trace_id, protocol, req_format, res_format, req_ip, req_port, res_ip, res_port, status_code, err_type, cost, req_time, res_time, req_bytes, res_bytes, create_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM tb_gw_trace_log WHERE ORDER BY req_time DESC LIMIT ${(current - 1) * size}, #{size}
SELECT FROM tb_gw_trace_log WHERE deleted = 0 AND id = #{id}
SELECT DISTINCT protocol FROM tb_gw_trace_log WHERE deleted = 0 AND protocol IS NOT NULL AND protocol != '' ORDER BY protocol
SELECT DISTINCT status_code FROM tb_gw_trace_log WHERE deleted = 0 AND status_code IS NOT NULL AND status_code > 0 ORDER BY status_code

SELECT DISTINCT t.app_id, t.service_name AS serviceId, COALESCE(NULLIF(s.service_name, ''), t.service_name) AS serviceName FROM tb_gw_trace_log t LEFT JOIN tb_gw_service s ON s.service_id = t.service_name AND s.deleted = 0 WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.service_name IS NOT NULL AND t.service_name != '' ORDER BY t.service_name

SELECT t.app_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(s.app_name, ''), t.app_name) AS app_name FROM tb_gw_trace_log t JOIN ( SELECT app_id, MAX(id) AS mid FROM tb_gw_trace_log WHERE deleted = 0 AND app_id IS NOT NULL AND app_id != '' GROUP BY app_id ) m ON m.mid = t.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT app_id, MAX(id) AS sid FROM tb_gw_service WHERE deleted = 0 AND app_id IS NOT NULL AND app_id != '' GROUP BY app_id ) sm ON sm.app_id = t.app_id LEFT JOIN tb_gw_service s ON s.id = sm.sid ORDER BY t.app_id
SELECT DISTINCT api FROM tb_gw_trace_log WHERE deleted = 0 AND api IS NOT NULL AND api != '' ORDER BY api
SELECT DISTINCT SUBSTRING_INDEX(api, ' ', 1) FROM tb_gw_trace_log WHERE deleted = 0 AND api LIKE '% %' ORDER BY 1
SELECT DISTINCT req_format FROM tb_gw_trace_log WHERE deleted = 0 AND req_format IS NOT NULL AND req_format != '' ORDER BY req_format
SELECT DISTINCT res_format FROM tb_gw_trace_log WHERE deleted = 0 AND res_format IS NOT NULL AND res_format != '' ORDER BY res_format
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO tb_gw_trace_log (app_id, app_name, service_name, api, req_params, trace_id, protocol, req_format, res_format, req_ip, req_port, res_ip, res_port, status_code, err_type, cost, req_time, res_time, req_header, res_header, req_body, res_body, req_bytes, res_bytes, create_time, deleted) VALUES
(#{l.appId}, #{l.appName}, #{l.serviceName}, #{l.api}, #{l.reqParams}, #{l.traceId}, #{l.protocol}, #{l.reqFormat}, #{l.resFormat}, #{l.reqIp}, #{l.reqPort}, #{l.resIp}, #{l.resPort}, #{l.statusCode}, #{l.errType}, #{l.cost}, #{l.reqTime}, #{l.resTime}, #{l.reqHeader}, #{l.resHeader}, #{l.reqBody}, #{l.resBody}, #{l.reqBytes}, #{l.resBytes}, #{l.createTime}, #{l.deleted})
